/srv/planeter/repos/r1/.prikk/active/default/active.lock
  kind: active
  recorded pid: 2
  recorded start: 1123856
  liveness: unknown: taken in another pid or time namespace, where this pid number or start time means something else; not proof it is safe to clear
/srv/planeter/repos/r1/.prikk/containers/objects.lock
  kind: container:object-store
  recorded pid: 2
  recorded start: 1123856
  liveness: unknown: taken in another pid or time namespace, where this pid number or start time means something else; not proof it is safe to clear

liveness is advisory only: "does not appear to be running" and "unknown" are NOT proof it is safe to clear. What each word means, and what each platform records to decide it, is defined in one place (https://prikk.org/docs/reference/concurrency-locking.html#what-the-three-liveness-words-mean). Clear a lock only if you have independently confirmed the process that created it is gone.
